description: This file contains unit tests for utility functions related to the MVC architecture in the SuiteCRM project. It tests functions such as loadParentView, getPrintLink, ajaxBannedModules, and ajaxLink, ensuring they behave correctly under various conditions.

classes.name: mvc_utilsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for utility functions in SuiteCRM, extending the SuitePHPUnitFrameworkTestCase for testing.

methods.name: testloadParentView
methods.description: Tests that loadParentView executes without throwing an exception.

methods.name: testgetPrintLink
methods.description: Tests the getPrintLink function for correct output with and without REQUEST parameters.

methods.name: testajaxLink
methods.description: Tests ajaxLink function output for multiple modules, considering whether AJAX UI is disabled.
